Cadastral map showing hydrostatic details, low and swamp lands, surveyed property lines, and key to names of surveyors whose plats make up this map. Platen, in the Office of the Librarian of Congress, at Washington." Sectioned in 2, joined together to form 1 sheet and mounted on cloth. Includes textual description of Chatham County's boundaries and eight districts in upper left corner.
